name: Lighter Than Air
description: Pin a rope and tie the balloons to it, then get the ball into the floating goal bucket.
hints: Ropes pin where you drop them and can tie to balloons: pin one end anywhere solid, then tie both balloons to the rope's end and they will strain against the tether instead of drifting off.
The goal bucket floats above the ground, so the ball must arrive from above — anything falling through the open mouth lands inside and counts.
